description: Complete the record: pass the BODY_JSON from prepare_credential_record UNCHANGED and the signature your wallet produced over MESSAGE_TO_SIGN. Relays to the same public door any HTTP client uses (POST /labor/credential-record); this server holds no keys and no funds. Free with a valid signature. The record is PENDING until a person has checked the issuer's public lookup; ask credential_record_status where it stands, because Vealth sends no email. Cost and signer: free, no gas; signed by the person's own wallet or passkey, and the house never holds a key.

bodyJson.description: The exact BODY_JSON string from prepare_credential_record, unchanged.
